summary: Dear #highered faculty stop pretending we can move our class online and everyone will just adapt. We will do everything so students succeed but do not blame students for " "not showing up."

Dear #highered faculty stop pretending we can move our class online and everyone will just adapt.

We will do everything so students succeed but do not blame students for " "not showing up."
